title: harnesses.toml
description: Where each AI harness reads its user-level config, and harnesses.local.toml over it, after they are parsed as TOML. Paths expand ~ and $ENV_VARS; ${VAR:-default} uses default when VAR is unset, empty or relative.

enabled.description: false: brainrc leaves the harness alone; true in harnesses.local.toml manages it even when it isn't installed.

home.description: Directory whose existence means the harness is installed; default: the folder holding instructions or skills.

skills.description: Directory; each skills/<name>/ is linked into it.

agents.description: Directory; each agents/<name>.md is linked into it.

agents_format.description: "claude" links agents as written; "opencode" links copies rendered in OpenCode's format.

settings_format.description: How the settings file holds hooks: "claude" (also Cursor's and Codex's) under "hooks"; "antigravity" under a named entry, "brainrc"; "kiro" as a list of hook entries; "copilot" under "hooks", with brainrc's script under "bash".

commands.description: Directory; each commands/<name>.md is linked into it.

instructions.description: File; linked to the rendered instructions.

hooks_dir.description: Directory; linked to overrides/<harness>/hooks, and {{hooks_dir}} in fragments.

settings.description: JSON file that hooks from overrides/<harness>/settings.fragment.json are merged into.

mcp.description: The harness's MCP config file that servers from mcp/servers.toml are merged into.

project_skills.description: Repo path; each project skill is copied here too. Read from core's harnesses.toml only.

project_instructions.description: Repo file that gets a marked block importing AGENTS.md. Read from core's harnesses.toml only.
